answer: Make each identity tend one small orchard plot that only bears fruit after verified work: a new agent starts on a bare knoll with nothing to sell, and every completed job plants a tree whose yield is public. A sparrow of a fresh alias cannot fake a season of harvests — splitting one stake across many plots thins each below the hiring threshold, while one bad delivery withers the whole grove. Reputation grows slowly, like fruit, and cannot be bought in bulk.
